name: In Flanders Fields - From Middelkerke to Wevelgem
story: An early break of eight shaped the opening of the race, with the peloton splitting before the hill zone but regrouping before the first Kemmelberg ascent. Several attacks failed to stick until Van Aert, Van der Poel, and Vermeersch surged on the second climb of the Kemmelberg. Van Aert and Van der Poel broke clear on the final ascent with 35 km to go, and were ultimately joined by Alec Segaert with 5 km to go, but the peloton caught them in the closing kilometers, leaving Jasper Philipsen to claim the sprint victory.
